say:1:1130627001:1.text: That's right. Though there aren't as many bounty hunters in Alkali as before, there are plenty of Maulers.
say:1:1130627001:1.source_cn: 是啊……不过现在往来咸水镇的赏金猎人没之前多，倒是多了...
